fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-18
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-17 11:30 to 2026-10-18 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: one, unchanged from yesterday (no new escalation this cycle).
- Fact: the standard says Field and Type names are snake_case, but all 151 Type, View, Composition, Blueprint and Vocabulary names in use are kebab-case (srs#236, P0, blocks the gate).
- Why it matters: whichever you pick becomes what third parties are told to follow; changing the written standard is yours, not the group's.
- Options and consequences: (1) rename all 151: text stays true, but it reaches the generator, every rendered page and every by-name reference. (2) keep Field names snake_case, document Type and Vocabulary names as kebab-case, split the shared `name` Field: matches practice, small change. (3) grandfather the 151, enforce only for new names: no rewrite, rule stays half-enforced.
- Recommendation: option 2. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (srs#236 stays blocked until you do).
- Record: proposed decision b80d2d1e. Detail: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/issues/236
Still waiting on you from before: srs-vscode#135 (owner-merge, open since 10-12); srs-rust#861 (doctor over MCP, split not yet filed); srs-rust#683 (parked behind ratified decision 31e9fd27, RFC next).

2. Decided within mandate: no decision was ready to ratify, so no group session was held. The builder's proposed decision 04b78189 (one definition filename scheme, srs-rust#1209) has the reviewer's assent and its PR merged (srs-rust#1405), but its record is on srs-programme#154, which is still open and now conflicted with master, so it stays proposed (about 1.5 days). No owner ruling for this group was found in the group log this cycle.

3. Done: 3 group PRs merged (builder / reviewer / mandate):
- srs-rust#1407 replace stale SKILL.md with a general SRS skill (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / charter 00567bf1; re-reviewed after master was merged into the branch)
- srs#938 correct decision-compass 4-10 observability row (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / rfc-decision-4431046e)
- srs-rust#1410 refuse non-conforming fieldType on field create/update (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-032 [R3], charter 00567bf1)
Every one has a quorum comment (verdict approve, findings none, gates green at the head sha). Analyst nominations srs#936 and srs-rust#1396 are the issues these close.

4. Stuck or lost: no open group PRs except srs-vscode#135 (owner-merge, unstable, waiting on you). srs-programme#154 (decision 04b78189) is conflicted and needs a merge from master; srs-programme#115 (steward report 2026-10-12) is still open and conflicted: stale, safe to close. needs-input inside the group: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198, srs#236 (escalated above). No red gates reported by runs, no claims to release. srs-web#573 and #574 merged this cycle belong to another group (wg:agent-editor, owner-merge) and are not counted.

5. Budget: 3 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 0 open delegated PRs. Pause state: running (the 10-17 report is not yet acknowledged; 10-12 to 10-16 carry a thumbs-up).
5b. Awaiting ratification: decision 04b78189 (proposed, about 1.5 days, waiting on its PR) and escalation b80d2d1e (proposed, 1 day, waiting on your ruling). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: workable ready issues: srs-rust#1132 (sibling render order, P2), srs-vscode#133 (payload drift, P2); srs-vscode#134 is already PR #135. Three more `ready` are stopped (srs-rust#861, #683, #1198). No local priorities set. Top 3 in the Builder's order: srs-rust#1132, srs-vscode#133, then nothing workable. Open group PRs in flight: 0 delegated. Budget left: 7. **Queue running dry: 2 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** New work could come from the spec-to-implementation drift list, conformance gaps in unimplemented rulings, or unparking srs-rust#1198 once SP-78 is ranked. What waits on the owner: the decision above, srs-vscode#135. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-17 run nominated srs-rust#1396 and srs#936 with promote:ready (both now merged); nothing new since.

6b. Exercises: none open in the group log.

7. What we learned: the group merged 3 this cycle, down from 5, and both analyst nominations were consumed within a day, so throughput is now set by how fast the analyst can nominate, not by the clocks. A merged PR whose decision record rides a separate programme PR (04b78189) can stall for days on conflicts: the record PR needs the same upkeep as the code PR, or the builder should land the record with it. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) stays ready to unpark; flagged again for you.
